verdict.rationale: A public API is a fair question for a consumer AI assistant service, so the axis applies. The pack documents only end-user features: in-app chat, connectors that pull in OneDrive/Google data, and in-browser actions via Browse with Copilot. None of these is a documented public API a programmatic client could call, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404.
